title: Single-cell analysis of functional heterogeneity in DNA repair capacity
author: Jay Hesselberth
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uhyet7w

steps.title: GEM Generation
steps.instruction: Perform GEM generation following the 10x protocol (CG00052 Rev F / CG000075 Rev C) with specific modifications to the master mix (MM).

substeps.instruction: Subtract 5 µl from the Volume of Nuclease-free Water using the cell suspension volume calculator table.
Add 5 µl of 20x hairpin solution per sample to the MM after adding nuclease-free water and before adding cells (between steps 1.1C and 1.1D).

steps.title: GEM Collection and RT
steps.instruction: Collect GEMs from the chip and proceed directly to Post GEM-RT Cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Do not follow the standard 10x RT protocol, as the RT enzyme is not denatured.

steps.title: Post GEM-RT Cleanup and Fractionation
steps.instruction: Perform Post GEM-RT Cleanup using Silane Dynabeads (section 2.1 of 10x protocol). After elution in 35 µl, separate the mRNA and repair substrate fractions using SPRIselect (or Ampure XP) size selection.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect Reagent and add 0.6x volume (21 µl) to the eluate; pipette to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnetic strip until liquid is clear.
Transfer the supernatant (repair substrate fraction) to a new tube; do not discard.
The beads now contain the mRNA fraction.

steps.title: mRNA Fraction Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the mRNA fraction from the beads.

substeps.instruction: While beads are on the magnet, add 150 µl 80% EtOH.
Remove EtOH and repeat wash for a total of 2 washes.
Briefly spin down tubes, place back on magnet, and remove remaining EtOH.
Dry beads for 2 min.
Add 35.5 µl EB buffer (10x reagents) and incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet; once clear, remove 35 µl and place into a new tube for cDNA amplification per 10x protocol.

steps.title: Repair Substrate Fraction Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the repair substrate fraction from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 41 µl of SPRIselect Reagent (1.8x) to the repair substrate fraction and pipette to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on magnet; once clear, remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 100 µl 80% EtOH to the beads while on the magnet.
Remove EtOH and repeat wash for a total of 2 washes.
Briefly spin down tubes, place back on magnet, and remove remaining EtOH.
Dry beads for 2 min.
Add 20.5 µl of nuclease-free water and incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet; once clear, remove 20 µl and place into a new tube for library prep.

steps.title: End Repair
steps.instruction: Perform end repair on the 20 µl repair substrate fraction.

substeps.instruction: Mix NEB End repair kit on ice and add to the 20 µl repair substrate fraction.
Incubate at 20 °C for 30 minutes.
Transfer reaction to 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Add 130 µl of 0.4 M sodium acetate and 400 µl 100% EtOH.
Add 1 µl of glyco-blue coprecipitate (optional).
Vortex for 5 seconds and incubate at -20 °C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at >10000 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µl 80% EtOH.
Centrifuge again at >10000 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Carefully remove supernatant, dry pellet for 5 min, and resuspend in 20 µl nuclease free H2O.

steps.title: A-Tailing
steps.instruction: Perform A-tailing and cleanup of the end-repaired DNA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Transfer reaction to 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Add 130 µl of 0.4 M sodium acetate and 400 µl 100% EtOH.
Add 1 µl glyco-blue coprecipitate if necessary.
Vortex for 5 seconds and incubate at -20 °C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at >10000 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µl 80% EtOH.
Centrifuge again at >10000 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Carefully remove supernatant, dry pellet for 5 min, and resuspend in 20 µl nuclease free water.
Mix 20 µl of each 100 µM adapter piece in ST buffer (10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl).
Heat to 95 °C for 5 minutes, then cool at -0.1 C/sec to 4 °C.
Add 160 µL of cold ST buffer to create 10 µM adapters; aliquot 10 µL and freeze at -20 °C.
Thaw adapter aliquots on ice when ready for use.
Incubate ligation reaction at 20 °C for 30 min.
Add 36 µl (1.8x) Ampure XP beads to ligation reaction and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash 2x with 150 µl 80% EtOH with beads on magnet.
Dry beads for 2 min.
Resuspend beads in 20 µl H2O, incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature, place on magnet, and transfer supernatant to another tube.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Set up and run the PCR for the repair substrate fraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 µM primers by mixing 10 µl of 100 µM forward and reverse primers and diluting to 100 µl.
Add 34 µl master mix to PCR tube.
Add 3 µl 10 µM mixed indexed ILMN primers (unique index per sample).
Add 13 µl repair substrate fraction from adapter ligation.

steps.title: Library Quality Control and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Verify library size and perform final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 µl of PCR product on 10% 29:1 acrylamide TBE gel or Agilent D1000 tapesation (expected size 200-250 bp).
If library is absent, add more Phusion to PCR and perform 2-5 more cycles.
Add 49 µL (1x) AmpureXP beads to PCR reaction and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash 2x with 200 µl 80% EtOH and air dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 20.5 µl H20 and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnet and transfer 20 µl to a new tube.
Sequence at least 28x100.
